en.headline: Li-Ning Hong Kong Open badminton starts at Kai Tak Arena today
en.dek: The Super 500 tournament moves to the new venue for the first time, running until 22 November with a US$500,000 prize purse and outdoor game booths.
body: The Li-Ning Hong Kong Open Badminton Championships, part of the HSBC BWF World Tour Super 500, begins on Tuesday at Kai Tak Arena after 12 years at the Hong Kong Coliseum.

Organised by the Badminton Association of Hong Kong, China, the six-day event draws players from more than 20 countries and regions. The association said the move to the larger Kai Tak venue increases capacity by about 20 per cent and prepares for an upgrade to Super 750 status from 2027.

Outdoor game booths and photo spots open to the public near the arena entrance from today. Single-session tickets range from HK$70 to HK$980, with a premium all-session package at HK$5,000. The association said the total prize purse is US$500,000.
Matches on the opening day include qualifying rounds and first-round men’s and women’s doubles from 9am to 7pm. The tournament runs through Sunday.

zh.headline: 李寧香港公開羽毛球錦標賽今日於啟德體藝館開幕
zh.dek: 超級500賽事首度移師新場館，至22日完結，總獎金50萬美元，場外設遊戲攤位。
body: 李寧香港公開羽毛球錦標賽作為滙豐世界羽聯世界巡迴賽超級500一部分，周二起於啟德體藝館舉行，結束過去12屆在紅磡香港體育館的歷史。
由中國香港羽毛球總會主辦，為期六日的賽事吸引逾20個國家及地區選手參賽。總會表示，改至較大的啟德場館使座位容量增加約兩成，並為2027年起升級至超級750作準備。
體藝館入口附近的場外遊戲攤位及打卡點今日起對外開放。單節門票由70至980港元，全程通套票為5000港元。總會指總獎金為50萬美元。
首日賽程包括外圍賽及男雙、女雙首輪初賽，由上午9時至下午7時。賽事持續至周日。
